implementation_plan: All edits confined to train.py on branch autoloop/20260922-muon-owner-ns-split-r3 from 9a4caa7b. Read-only reference (adapt names, do not copy verbatim): research/scratch/fresh_start_train.py --experimental-optimizer-ownership path at the same commit. STEP 1 (static inspection, reported only as a note inside the implementation summary; no artifact file): open class MuonAdamW; locate step() (which calls _muon_step once per same-shape group), _muon_step, and the compiled module-level helper _muon_math it calls. Inside _muon_math identify three contiguous statement groups: (a) PRE = every statement up to and including the computation of the tensor that enters NS-input normalization (the out-of-place torch.lerp momentum update, Nesterov blend, any pre-NS dtype cast), noting that the updated momentum buffer is a RETURN value that _muon_step rebinds; (b) NS = the NS-input normalization statement(s) plus both Newton-Schulz loops through the last iteration, i.e. everything whose only batch-level inputs are the NS input and whose output is the orthogonalized batch; (c) POST = every statement after NS (shape-dependent scale such as sqrt(max(1, rows/cols)) if present, second-moment update/normalization, LR and weight-decay scaling, parameter update, construction of the return tuple). Confirm every rank currently runs group (b) for every matrix; if work is already split by rank followed by a collective, stop and report HALT-INERT. Also record how _muon_math is compiled (direct torch.compile decorator, or a per-shape cached compiled callable) and which flag values select alternate NS backends (--compile-muon / --nki-muon precedence). STEP 2 (toggle): following the existing --bf16-sdpa-input pattern, add module-level USE_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE = True with env override NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE ('0' disables), argparse pair --muon-owner-compute / --no-muon-owner-compute (dest muon_owner_compute, default None -> constant), resolved in main() before the optimizer is constructed. Do NOT add it to ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES (it does not affect forward, weights, checkpoints or evaluation). STEP 3 (extraction by moving statements, no rewriting): add three module-level helpers next to _muon_math: _muon_pre(<the subset of _muon_math's arguments used by group (a)>) containing exactly the group (a) statements and returning (new_momentum, ns_input) with the same out-of-place semantics (no in-place momentum update is introduced); _muon_ns(X) containing exactly the group (b) statements, taking a stacked batch of arbitrary leading size and returning the orthogonalized batch with the same dtype as today; _muon_post(orth_batch, <the subset of arguments used by group (c)>) containing exactly the group (c) statements and returning exactly the tensors _muon_math returns, in the same order, with the new momentum from _muon_pre passed through unchanged where _muon_math's return includes it. Apply the same compilation treatment _muon_math has to each helper (if _muon_math is a torch.compile-decorated function, decorate all three identically; if it is a per-shape cached compiled callable, create identical caches for each helper keyed the same way). Leave _muon_math itself in place and byte-for-byte unchanged; it remains the executed path when the ownership path is not taken and is the reference for STEP 5. STEP 4 (partition in _muon_step): compute owner_active = USE_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE and torch.distributed.is_available() and torch.distributed.is_initialized() and world_size > 1 and n >= 2 and <the NS backend selected by the existing flags is the default _muon_math path, i.e. no alternate backend such as --nki-muon is active>. If owner_active is False, call _muon_math exactly as today. Otherwise: (i) momentum_new, G = _muon_pre(...) with G of shape [n, *shape]; rebind the momentum state exactly where _muon_step rebinds the _muon_math return today; (ii) per_rank = (n + world_size - 1) // world_size; start = rank * per_rank; owned = G[start:min(start + per_rank, n)]; if owned has fewer than per_rank rows, pad by concatenating copies of G[0:1] until the local stack has static shape [per_rank, *shape] (no zero matrices are introduced, so no normalization guard changes; padded outputs are discarded); (iii) local_out = _muon_ns(local_stack); (iv) allocate out_all of shape [world_size * per_rank, *shape] with local_out's dtype and device and call torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(out_all, local_out) on the default process group; if all_gather_into_tensor is unavailable or raises NotImplementedError for the active backend, use torch.distributed.all_gather([torch.empty_like(local_out) for _ in range(world_size)], local_out) followed by torch.cat in rank order; (v) full_out = out_all[:n] (rank-order concatenation, so index k of full_out is matrix k of the batch under the contiguous mapping in (ii)); (vi) results = _muon_post(full_out, ...) and rebind/apply exactly as _muon_step does with _muon_math's return today. Perform the collective in ordinary (lazy-XLA/eager) code, not inside a compiled region. Do not change parameter iteration order, state tensors, gradient all-reduce, clipping, --clip-after-reduce/--grad-bucket logic, AdamW/ngram-ve optimizers, schedules, model, data or evaluation code. STEP 5 (one-time-per-group equivalence check, diagnostics only): keep a module-level dict _MUON_OWNER_CHECKED keyed by (tuple(shape), n). On the first _muon_step call for a key whose ownership path is taken: before executing STEP 4, clone every tensor argument that the original _muon_math call would receive (parameters, gradients/NS inputs, momentum, second-moment state) and run ref = _muon_math(*cloned_args) on the clones; also compute ref_ns = _muon_ns(G) on the full batch after (i). After STEP 4 completes, compute for each of: ns_out (full_out vs ref_ns), param (each updated parameter tensor vs its clone counterpart after the reference update, whether returned or updated in place), momentum, and second_moment: max_abs_diff = (candidate - reference).abs().max(), max_abs_ref = reference.abs().max(); print on rank 0 one line 'muon_owner_check shape=<shape> n=<n> ns_out_diff=<f> ns_out_ref=<f> param_diff=<f> param_ref=<f> mom_diff=<f> mom_ref=<f> sm_diff=<f> sm_ref=<f>' (a handful of .item() syncs once per group). The real update always uses the split-path results; the clones and references are discarded. Mark the key checked so the check runs once per group. STEP 6 (logging): add exactly one field 'muon_owner_compute=<bool>' to the existing optimizer/sched_tricks config oneliner printed at startup; if owner_active is forced False because an alternate NS backend is selected, print one line 'muon_owner_compute: disabled (non-default NS backend)' at startup. STEP 7 (static self-review inside the implementation summary; no execution required): state that the diff is limited to the toggle/env/CLI resolution, the three moved-statement helpers, the ownership/all_gather block in _muon_step, the once-per-group check, and the log field; state that _muon_math is unchanged and is the path taken when the toggle is off, world_size == 1, n < 2, or a non-default NS backend is selected; state that forward/eval code, ARCH_TOGGLE_NAMES, checkpoint format and optimizer state tensors are unchanged; quote the group (a)/(b)/(c) boundaries by line range. Runtime verification belongs to the Operator's smoke run per the abort conditions. Launch smoke and full with the exact control launch command and environment (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2 torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=4 train.py --num-steps 5000 --max-train-seconds 1800 --seed 42; NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1', NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1) and no additional flags.
single_causal_change: One optimizer-implementation change confined to train.py: when the new module-level toggle USE_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE is on (default True; env NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_MUON_OWNER_COMPUTE='0' disables; CLI --muon-owner-compute/--no-muon-owner-compute), torch.distributed is initialized with world_size > 1, the batch has n >= 2 matrices, and the Muon backend selected by the existing flags is the default compiled _muon_math path the pinned control uses, MuonAdamW._muon_step runs the SAME arithmetic as _muon_math split at the NS stage: (pre) the out-of-place momentum/Nesterov statements run on every rank and return the new momentum buffer (rebound exactly as today) plus the NS input; (ns) the NS statements (input normalization through the last NS iteration, moved verbatim into a helper) run on every rank only for a contiguous owned slice of the batch (rank r owns indices [r*per_rank, min((r+1)*per_rank, n)), per_rank = ceil(n/world_size), local stack of static shape [per_rank, *shape], unowned slots filled with copies of matrix 0 and discarded), then ONE torch.distributed all_gather reconstructs the full orthogonalized batch in rank order sliced to n; (post) the remaining statements (shape-dependent scale, second-moment normalization, LR/weight-decay scaling, parameter update) run on every rank on the reconstructed batch and return exactly what _muon_math returns. Contiguous ownership is the only mapping used. Momentum/second-moment state layout, optimizer state and checkpoint format, gradient all-reduce, clipping, AdamW/ngram-ve optimizers, schedules, model, forward/eval code, data, seed, evaluator, launch shape and environment are untouched. With the toggle off, world_size == 1, n < 2, or a non-default NS backend (e.g. --nki-muon) selected, the unchanged _muon_math executes. Full-run classification versus the same-host pinned control, evaluated in order: (1) HALT-INERT if static inspection finds NS already partitioned across ranks (no patch, no run); (2) HALT-NUMERICS if the smoke log lacks a 'muon_owner_check' line for any partitioned shape group, or any such line reports a max_abs_diff > 1e-3 * max_abs_ref for the NS output, updated parameters, momentum, or second-moment state, or smoke causality_passed is False; (3) CONFOUNDED-SHORT if full-run steps < 90% of same-host control (<1864 trn21, <1869 trn22); (4) FALSIFIED-INERT if steps within +/-1% of control (redundant NS is not a measurable cost at this model size); (5) SUCCESS if steps >= +2% of control and public_val_bpb < same-host control by >= 0.001; (6) FALSIFIED-QUALITY if steps >= +2% and public_val_bpb >= control; (7) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise, including +1..2% steps, or >= +2% steps with a positive gain smaller than 0.001. If steps exceed +10% (>2278 trn21, >2283 trn22) the verdict is still assigned by (5)-(7) on the fixed-budget public_val_bpb; the Analyst additionally records the muon_owner_check lines and the smoothed training-loss log value at the control's final step count as attribution notes only (they are not validation BPB and do not alter the verdict).
